# Shagun Mart (Sagun Lengha Chunari Center) – Bamitha, MP

> Shagun Mart (also registered as Sagun Lengha Chunari Center / शगुन लहंगा चुनरी सेंटर) is a premier bridal lehenga showroom, churi (bangles) center, and bridal makeup salon in Bamitha, Chhatarpur district, Madhya Pradesh (PIN: 471105).

## Verified Business Details
- **Official Name:** Shagun Mart – Lehenga & Churi Center
- **Google Maps Listing:** Sagun Lengha Chunari Center
- **Physical Address:** Khajuraho Road, Bamitha, District Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh - 471105, India
- **Geo Coordinates:** 24.7718768, 79.8748559
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91-8827259023
- **Operating Hours:** Open 7 Days a week from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM (07:00 – 21:00 IST)
- **Service Radius:** Bamitha, Khajuraho (10–12 km), Chhatarpur (30 km), Panna (40–45 km)

## Offerings & Core Capabilities
1. **Bridal & Party-Wear Lehengas:** Heavy velvet zardozi bridal lehengas, pastel reception lehengas, sangeet and haldi outfits.
2. **Churi & Bangles Center:** Customized bridal chudas, lac bangles, velvet metal bangles, and exact fabric-matched glass bangles.
3. **Bridal Makeup & Beauty Parlour:** In-house professional bridal makeover packages, pre-bridal grooming, and event makeup services.
4. **Wedding Essentials:** Shagun envelopes, bridal dupattas, potlis, and in-store alteration/fitting support.
